# `company.inventory_transfer_lines`

Immutable lines of an inventory transfer revision.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Revision-local line ULID. |

| `line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with revision_id + line_id | — | — | Stable line identity carried across revisions. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with revision_id + position | — | — | One-based position within the revision. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | items.id | Inventory item moved. |

| `unit_factor_nanounits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Base units per entered unit, in nano-units. |
| `from_bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin the stock left; null for no bin. |
| `to_bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin the stock arrived in; null for no bin. |
